hooks.note: the pre-existing test hooks still resolve to their own reasons, so the split did not swallow them

isEdaNotConnectedNowReachable.question: the task asks to make EDA_NOT_CONNECTED a reachable branch
isEdaNotConnectedNowReachable.answer: yes, and by the real path rather than only by the hook
isEdaNotConnectedNowReachable.why: previously discover() threw SCHEMATIC_BRIDGE_NO_EDA and the catch-all turned it into BRIDGE_UNREACHABLE, so the execute-time NO_EDA branch at L129 could never be reached in the zero-window state. Now discover() reports BRIDGE_NO_EDA_WINDOW and returns, so a window that exists at discover time and disappears before or during execute falls through to the execute handler, where NO_EDA / not connected / edaConnected text maps to EDA_NOT_CONNECTED.
isEdaNotConnectedNowReachable.honestLimit: I could not exercise that execute-time transition this round, because reaching execute requires a registered window and there is none. The claim is therefore structural (the guard no longer shadows it) plus hook-verified (T53_FORCE_NO_EDA still yields EDA_NOT_CONNECTED), not an observed live NO_EDA-after-successful-discover.

taxonomy.requirement: mutually exclusive, exhaustive, and explicitly answering whether a fourth branch is needed
taxonomy.verdictOnFourthBranch: YES - a fourth branch is needed, and in fact a fifth, plus an explicit success terminal. A three-branch taxonomy cannot be exhaustive: the client itself can report nine transport codes (bridge.ts L55-66: UNAVAILABLE, NO_EDA, TIMEOUT, CIRCUIT_OPEN, EXECUTION, PROTOCOL, CONNECT_TIMEOUT, DISCONNECTED, WINDOW_LOST), so any three-way split must merge distinct faults.

branches.name: nothing is listening
branches.detection: every scanned port 49620-49630 refuses TCP (ECONNREFUSED) and therefore yields no HTTP /health response
branches.means: the relay process is not running

branches.name: relay up, zero editor windows
branches.detection: a port answers GET /health with 200 and the body has service=easyeda-bridge, bridge=dsh-eda-bridge, edaConnected=false, edaWindowCount=0
branches.means: the transport is healthy; the editor page has not registered with this relay instance

branches.name: a window is registered but the call fails
branches.detection: /health reports edaWindowCount>=1 (and/or edaConnected=true), yet POST /execute fails or times out
branches.means: the fault is inside the registered window - it went away mid-call, or the page-side gateway is busy/wedged
branches.t53Reason: EDA_NOT_CONNECTED when the failure text says the window is gone; BRIDGE_CALL_FAILED otherwise

branches.name: a port answers but it is not this bridge (fourth branch, REQUIRED)
branches.detection: TCP connects and something answers, but /health is absent, not JSON, or its service/bridge id differs from easyeda-bridge / dsh-eda-bridge
branches.means: another daemon squats the port; bridge.ts keeps scanning (L331-332) and, if nothing else answers, collapses this into UNAVAILABLE - so the CLIENT cannot tell (a) from (d), which is why the taxonomy must name it separately
branches.t53Reason: BRIDGE_UNREACHABLE (indistinguishable from (a) at t53's level; stated as a known limit, not silently merged)
branches.clientCode: SCHEMATIC_BRIDGE_UNAVAILABLE (merged with (a)), or SCHEMATIC_BRIDGE_PROTOCOL when a response shape is unrecognised

branches.name: a port accepts TCP but the probe stalls (fifth branch, REQUIRED for exhaustiveness)
branches.detection: TCP connect succeeds, yet GET /health does not answer within the probe deadline
branches.means: a hung or half-open listener, or a firewall swallowing the response
branches.t53Reason: BRIDGE_UNREACHABLE today (the discover timeout also lands in the same catch); noted as a remaining conflation, out of this task's scope

branches.name: terminal state, not a failure branch
branches.detection: /health edaConnected=true and edaWindowCount>=1 and execute returns data
branches.means: the gate can actually judge; exit 0 (all five invariants) or 1 (an invariant broke)

taxonomy.mutualExclusivity: each state is decided by two observations only - whether a port yields an /health response, and what that response says about edaConnected / edaWindowCount - so exactly one branch applies at a time. (a) and (d) both yield 'no usable bridge' at the client, which is an acknowledged merge in bridge.ts, not an ambiguity introduced here.

httpStatusIsNotACriterion.rule: 500 / 503 must NOT appear in any branch definition. The status code varies by relay version and by which layer answers, so it identifies nothing.
httpStatusIsNotACriterion.evidence: POST /execute in the zero-window state returns 503 with {"success":false,"error":"No EDA window connected. Please connect an EDA window first."} - measured by r8t1 and re-measurable today. The REGISTER_HINT text says a landing-only window answers 500, i.e. a DIFFERENT state (a window that registered but has no project).
httpStatusIsNotACriterion.whoAlreadySaidSo: r8t1 line 83: 'DISCREPANCY WITH THE TASK'S PREMISE, stated plainly: the response is 503, not 500, and the body is NOT the EASYEDA_BRIDGE_REGISTER_HINT text.' r8t1 line 174 lists 'the relay returns HTTP 500 with the REGISTER_HINT sentence when no editor is attached' among the beliefs it corrects.
httpStatusIsNotACriterion.correctionOfTheRecord: the 'branch b = 500 + REGISTER_HINT' wording originated in the t1/r8t1 task prompt, not in r8t1's own text: r8t1 kept the prompt's branch label 'b' but replaced its criterion with 'relay up, edaConnected false, 0 windows'. So the self-contradiction was in the inherited label, and r8t1 had already flagged it. The fix is to strip the code from the definition, which is what the taxonomy above does.

correctionsKept.kept: 49620 and 49630 listening simultaneously is ONE relay instance, not two daemons: bin/dsh-eda-bridge.mjs L18-22 makes 49630 the fixed second listener for the editor's built-in run-api-gateway; the HTTP API takes the first free port in 49620-49629.
the relay does not answer 500 with the REGISTER_HINT sentence when no editor is attached; it answers 503 with a short JSON error. The hint is composed client-side in bridge.ts L47.
